column3: “Made them complete destruction” is rendered “make an end of them.”
“Did not do your law” is rendered “have not kept Your law,” and “testimonies” as “admonitions.”
“Increasing” is rendered “abundant,” and “in our sins” as “because of our sins.”
MT 10:1. “A trustworthy arrangement and writing” is rendered “an agreement in writing”; NASB supplies “the names of.”
